**brain-drafts/adr-0023 draft is malformed (two Status lines) — #312 inherits an unpromotable draft**

**What**: During #599's design phase, measured that brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md carries two `**Status**:` lines — the same malformation class as adr-0029 (#676) and the pre-#675 adr-0023 promote incident. promote-guards.mjs will refuse it as-is.
**Why**: #599 deliberately leaves the draft untouched (out of scope by proposal). When #312 (SDD role port) is worked, its ADR-0023 must be written fresh from shipped code or the draft repaired before brain:promote.
**Where**: brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md; promote-guards.mjs; ticket #312.
**Learned**: Worth a note on #312 so the inheritance is visible — candidate comment when #599's PR lands.
